ptz_parking.note: Eyeball (frames viewed at 1 s steps around 150-165 s, then every 21 s): the PTZ holds its home view until ~155.5 s, swings to a zoomed hedge/pole view (156-205 s), then to an extreme zoom on a licence plate (~205-240 s), then settles on a different, closer wide view of the same car park (~240-316 s). It never returns to the home framing.

rochester_night.note: Eyeball (frames at 1 s steps 17-28 s, then every 4 s to 84 s): the opening framing (building + lamp, cars crossing) holds until ~22 s, then the camera pans right to a tree-lined view (23 s on) and keeps wandering (76 s: building facade, 80 s: junction). The opening framing never returns. The scene is night but well exposed (lamps lit): not DARK.
